blog.title: 我们为什么坚持手工装配唱片

body.value: 关于一台老式刻片机、丝网印刷，和「数量有限」这件事。
设备清单、踩过的坑，以及那些意外好听的错误。

idlework Records 是由 Zhong 在 2015 年于广西玉林市建立的DIY音乐厂牌，自主手工发行他和好朋友们制作的音乐和艺术。

受到朋克音乐与DIY手工文化的影响，idlework 热衷于在玉林举办乐队现场表演活动，为好友们提供一种社区型的展演、娱乐、观影空间。

如果机会允许，我们希望在更多的地方、空间、城市举办这样的活动。或许在将来的以后，我们会运营一家实体唱片店。（如果你也有兴趣，欢迎找我们聊聊，也可以投资我们 ：）

感谢所有支持、参与、以及组成“这件事”（音乐、乐队、现场表演等等）的人们。

bodyEn.value:
idlework Records is a DIY music label founded by Zhong in 2015 in Yulin, Guangxi. It serves primarily as a platform for the independent, handmade release of music & ARTS created by him and his friends.

Influenced by punk music and DIY culture, idlework is passionate about organizing live band performances in Yulin, creating a community-oriented space for friends to showcase their work, be entertained, and watch films.

Given the opportunity, we hope to host similar events in more locations, venues, and cities. Perhaps down the line, we might even run a brick-and-mortar record store. (If you’re interested, feel free to reach out for a chat—or even invest in us! :)

We are grateful to everyone who has supported, participated in, and helped shape "whole this thing" (the music, the bands, the live shows, and more).
